title: Implemented authenticated owner intents and Amity management payloads
$comment: Closed typed owner delivery plus existing management. Scoped recipients resolve locally; no persisted enabled, route/binding/domain/resource approvals or prepared execution plans. Exact membership/boot/config/input authorization remains runtime enforcement.

supported_tentacles.description: Configured hardware-profile CEC port capacity. Omitted legacy fields mean capacity1 and mask1.

configured_tentacles_mask.description: GPIO-assigned profile slots, not physical population. Bit n covers both sides of slot n; zero is a valid all-unassigned profile.

osd_name.description: Exact nonempty OSD text from the shared CEC decoder, not the UI label. No case folding or trimming. The decoder also enforces the CEC payload octet budget; this schema checks decoded text only.

target.description: Persisted qualified device selector. Discovery resolves its exact OSD name to a separate runtime CEC address; no logical address is stored here.

KeyEdges.description: One physical button edge or an atomic same-key down/up tap. The pair enum enforces equality without nonstandard schema extensions.
